verdict.rationale: Source availability under an open license is a fair question for any software product, including a SaaS team inbox like Missive. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a public source repository or an open-source license. The only openness material covers a REST API, MCP access, and Markdown documentation, which are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
